description: Keyboard shortcuts for Firefox tab groups: open new tabs inside a group, move tabs between groups, switch between groups, and collapse or expand them.
name: Tab Group Hotkeys

new-tab-in-group.description: Open a new tab in the current tab group

new-tab-in-chosen-group.description: Open a new tab in a chosen tab group

add-tab-to-group.description: Add the current tab to a tab group

next-group.description: Switch to the next tab group

previous-group.description: Switch to the previous tab group
